2068 CAMPAIGN ARCHIVE

KLINTON ARKAS | FOR CARNAPOL MP | 2068
NEW PROGRESSIVE PARTY

This brief records the 2068 campaign. Offices, candidacy and commitments described below refer to that campaign, not the 2072 election. The original campaign material is preserved here for reference.

THE FUTURE IS OURS.
Rooted in Dubois. Working for Carnapol. Ready for what comes next.

MEET KLINTON
Born and raised in Dubois. First elected Carnapol MP in 2056. Now leader of the New Progressive Party and seeking a fourth term. In his supplied speeches, Klinton describes eleven years of service and holding four ministerial portfolios at once.

HIS PRIORITIES
Artificial intelligence: Klinton says that, as Minister of Energy, he supported construction of a major AI data centre in Carnapol in the year before his speech. He pledges continued support and resources for AI.
Scientific progress: he promises vital support for space exploration, quantum technology and new technological breakthroughs.
Representation: he wants Carnapol's voice to resonate in Montiablo and puts people-centered politics above ideological divisions.

THE 2068 PARTY PLATFORM
The NPP proposes more housing supply, stronger public healthcare and education, nuclear and renewable energy, better regional transport, and accountable government. These are party commitments, not a list of Klinton's personal achievements.

IN HIS WORDS
"I never took a single step back from serving you."
"We have always said that the future is ours, and we have worked to become the architects of that future."
"The choice is entirely yours, but remember: I trust you."

Read both speeches in full in the campaign archive. All candidate claims in this brief come from those speeches. The broader platform comes from the 2068 NPP website and supplied manifesto.

Fictional campaign. Hayden Christensen is the visual face claim; no endorsement is implied.
